verdict.rationale: The Google Cloud compliance resource center documents attestations that cover BigQuery, including SOC 1/2/3 and HIPAA support, with downloadable reports per certification. That directly helps a security review. PCI is not named explicitly, only implied under 'sector/regional programs'. missing for 10: explicit PCI DSS attestation for BigQuery, BigQuery-specific compliance documentation detail (e.g., HIPAA BAA scope), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, compliance attestations (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI) are documented so security review does not stall the rollout

citations.quote: Google Cloud compliance resource center lists BigQuery-covered attestations and certifications including ISO 9001:2015, ISO 22301:2019, ISO 50001:2018, SOC 1/2/3, HIPAA support, and sector/regional programs, with downloadable reports per certification.
